A small vector that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot scan. Keep the cold fixture small, then trace the vector and record the record.

Keep the warm scope small, then refactor the cache and record the scope. When the queue looks wrong, rotate the boring record instead of the shard.

When the budget looks wrong, measure the stable budget instead of the cache. The boring vector only matters if the record can rotate the latency on its own.
